title: Classic Snake Game: A Beginner-Friendly Web Project
description:
🎮 Welcome to the Classic Snake Game! 🐍

🔥 About the Project

This lightweight and interactive game brings back the timeless arcade experience, built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Guide the snake across the canvas, eat food to grow, and aim for the highest score—but be careful not to collide with yourself!

🚀 What You’ll Learn

This project is an excellent resource for beginners to grasp core programming concepts, including:
✅ Game loops – Managing the game’s continuous updates
✅ Collision detection – Handling interactions between objects
✅ Dynamic styling – Enhancing the user experience

🕹️ Key Features

🎯 Responsive canvas-based gameplay
📊 Real-time score tracking
🎨 Simple & clean UI with a retro vibe
⌨️ Keyboard controls (Arrow keys for navigation)

💡 Get Creative!

Whether you're learning to code or sharpening your skills, this project is a hands-on way to explore:
🔹 DOM manipulation
🔹 Event listeners
🔹 HTML5 Canvas API

Feel free to tweak the code, add new features, or customize the design—make it your own! 🚀🎨

Happy coding! 👨‍💻👩‍💻
shortDescription: A simple yet engaging implementation of the classic Snake game built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Perfect for learners and developers to explore fundamental web development concepts like DOM manipulation, canvas rendering, and event handling.
